knowledge:
- key_parameters: <annotate=Variable (e.g., gene name, metadata column) used to color or annotate the plot ;; in_tissue=Specifies whether to subset to spots in tissue; must be set to NULL for imaging-based spatial transcriptomics data ;; point_size=Numeric value to adjust the size of the plotted points/spots ;; point_shape=Shape of the points (default is 16 in plotCoords and 21 in plotVisium; should be updated to 15 and 22 respectively for Visium HD square bins) ;; highlight=Metadata column used to highlight specific spots (e.g., "in_tissue") ;; pal=Color palette name or vector of colors (e.g., "libd_layer_colors", "Okabe-Ito", "rainbow", "viridis", "magma", "plasma") ;; image=Logical indicating whether to show the H&E histology image in plotVisium ;; spots=Logical indicating whether to show the spots in plotVisium ;; plot_type=Type of plot to generate (e.g., "histogram", "violin", "spot", "scatter" for plotObsQC; "histogram", "violin" for plotFeatureQC; "UMAP", "PCA" for plotDimRed) ;; x_metric=Metric to plot on the x-axis for QC plots ;; y_metric=Metric to plot on the y-axis for QC plots ;; x_threshold=Threshold value to draw a vertical line on scatter QC plots ;; y_threshold=Threshold value to draw a horizontal line on scatter QC plots ;; text_by=Column name to overlay text labels over clusters ;; text_by_size=Size of the overlay text labels ;; text_by_color=Color of the overlay text labels ;; zoom=Logical indicating whether to zoom in on the image (used in plotVisium for Visium HD)>
- alternatives: <None mentioned in the documentation; the package is designed specifically to integrate with SpatialExperiment and SingleCellExperiment objects>
- when_to_use: <Use this package when you need to visualize spatial transcriptomics data from sequencing-based platforms (e.g., 10x Genomics Visium, Visium HD, Slide-seq) or imaging-based platforms (e.g., Xenium, CosMx, MERSCOPE, STARmapPLUS), perform spatial quality control, or visualize dimension reduction results with spatial annotations>
- pitfalls: <plotVisium requires a SpatialExperiment object containing image data, whereas other functions accept either SpatialExperiment or SingleCellExperiment objects ;; in_tissue must be set to NULL for all imaging-based spatial transcriptomics datasets ;; Default point shapes (16 or 21) must be manually changed to square shapes (15 or 22) when plotting Visium HD square bin data to avoid visual gaps or incorrect representations>

workflows.name: spatial_coordinate_and_visium_plotting
workflows.intent: Visualize spatial coordinates, gene expression, and histology overlays for sequencing-based spatial transcriptomics data.
input: spe_vm (SpatialExperiment object for Visium mouse coronal)
spe (SpatialExperiment object for Visium human DLPFC)
workflows.stages: 1. Plot spatial coordinates for Slide-seq data using plotCoords ;; 2. Plot Visium spots overlaid on histology using plotVisium ;; 3. Plot gene expression spatially using plotVisium and plotCoords ;; 4. Plot Visium spots without histology or histology without spots ;; 5. Plot categorical annotations using custom palettes ;; 6. Plot Visium HD square bins using custom point shapes
workflows.code:
(plotCoords(spe_slide, annotate = "celltype", 
            in_tissue = NULL, point_size = 0.1) + 
  guides(color=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3), ncol = 2)) |
  plotCoords(spe_slide, annotate = "loglibsize", 
             in_tissue = NULL, point_size = 0.1) + 
  scale_color_gradient(name = "Log library size") + ggtitle("")) +
  plot_annotation(title = 'Slide-seq V2 Mouse Brain')

p1 <- plotVisium(spe_vm, annotate = "sum", highlight = "in_tissue", 
                 legend_position = "none")
p2 <- plotVisium(spe_vm, annotate = "sum", highlight = "in_tissue", 
                 pal = "darkred") + 
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(title = "Libsize"))

p1 | p2

p1 <- plotVisium(spe_vm, annotate = "Gapdh", highlight = "in_tissue")
p2 <- plotVisium(spe_vm, annotate = "Mbp", highlight = "in_tissue")

p1 | p2

p1 <- plotVisium(spe_vm, annotate = "Mbp", 
                 highlight = "in_tissue", image = FALSE)
p2 <- plotVisium(spe_vm, annotate = "Mbp", 
                 highlight = "in_tissue", spots = FALSE)

p1 | p2

p1 <- plotCoords(spe_vm, annotate = "Gapdh")
p2 <- plotCoords(spe_vm, annotate = "Mbp", pal = "viridis")

p1 | p2

plotVisium(spe, annotate = "ground_truth", highlight = "in_tissue", 
           pal = "libd_layer_colors")

p1 <- plotCoords(spe, annotate = "ground_truth", pal = "Okabe-Ito") +
  ggtitle("Reference")
p2 <- plotCoords(spe, annotate = "libsize", pal = "rainbow") + 
  ggtitle("Library size")

p1 | p2

plotCoords(vhd8, point_shape=15, point_size = 1.7, annotate="PIGR") | 
  plotVisium(vhd8, point_shape=22, point_size = 2, annotate="PIGR", 
           zoom = TRUE)

workflows.name: quality_control_plotting
workflows.intent: Generate spot-level and feature-level quality control plots to identify low-quality spots or lowly abundant features.
input: spe (SpatialExperiment object with calculated QC metrics in colData and rowData)
workflows.stages: 1. Plot spot-level QC metrics using histograms, violins, and spatial spot plots via plotObsQC ;; 2. Plot bivariate QC relationships using scatter plots with thresholds via plotObsQC ;; 3. Plot feature-level QC metrics using histograms and violins via plotFeatureQC
workflows.code:
p1 <- plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "histogram", 
                x_metric = "sum", annotate = "low_libsize")
p2 <- plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "violin", 
                x_metric = "sum", annotate = "low_libsize", point_size = 0.1)
p3 <- plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "spot", in_tissue = "in_tissue", 
                annotate = "low_libsize", point_size = 0.2)

p1 | p2 | p3

p1 <- plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "histogram", 
                x_metric = "subsets_mito_percent", annotate = "high_mito")
p2 <- plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "violin", 
                x_metric = "subsets_mito_percent", annotate = "high_mito", 
                point_size = 0.1)
p3 <- plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "spot", in_tissue = "in_tissue", 
                annotate = "high_mito", point_size = 0.2)

p1 | p2 | p3

plotObsQC(spe, plot_type = "scatter", 
          x_metric = "subsets_mito_percent", y_metric = "sum", 
          x_threshold = 30, y_threshold = 400)

p1 <- plotFeatureQC(spe, plot_type = "histogram", 
                    x_metric = "feature_sum", annotate = "low_abundance")
p2 <- plotFeatureQC(spe, plot_type = "violin", 
                    x_metric = "feature_sum", annotate = "low_abundance")

p1 | p2

workflows.name: imaging_based_and_dimred_plotting
workflows.intent: Visualize imaging-based spatial transcriptomics coordinates and reduced dimensions with text annotations.
input: spe_sta (SpatialExperiment object for STARmapPLUS with reduced dimensions calculated)
workflows.stages: 1. Plot imaging-based coordinates with in_tissue = NULL using plotCoords ;; 2. Overlay text labels on spatial clusters using text_by in plotCoords ;; 3. Plot reduced dimensions (e.g., UMAP) with cluster text overlays using plotDimRed
workflows.code:
plotCoords(spe_xen, annotate = "cell_area", in_tissue = NULL, pal = "magma",
           point_size = 0.15) + ggtitle("Xenium Breast Cancer") |
  plotCoords(spe_cos, annotate = "Area", in_tissue = NULL, pal = "plasma", 
             point_size = 0.1) + ggtitle("CosMx Breast Cancer") |
  plotCoords(spe_mer, annotate = "volume", in_tissue = NULL, 
             pal = c("navyblue", "yellow"),
             point_size = 0.05) + ggtitle("MERSCOPE Ovarian Cancer")

plotCoords(spe_sta, annotate = "Main_molecular_tissue_region", in_tissue = NULL,
           point_size = 0.1, text_by = "Main_molecular_tissue_region",
           text_by_size = 4, text_by_color = "#2d2d2d")

plotDimRed(spe_sta, plot_type = "UMAP",
           annotate = "Main_molecular_tissue_region", 
           text_by = "Main_molecular_tissue_region",
           text_by_size = 3, text_by_color = "#2d2d2d")
